test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

25, 36, 49, 64, 81,?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Each next term in the series is the square of the consecutive natural number which is starting with '5'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d16e5705cfff886dfa8eb936a1cc4780d56bf26d78d87d435f404d699be3c718.png] 

Hence, "100" will replace the question mark (?) in the given series.
